Neuralink is creating devices that enable a bi-directional interface with the brain, aiming to restore movement to the paralyzed and revolutionize human interaction with digital technology. The Software Engineer in the BCI Applications Team will collaborate with clinical trial participants to engineer brain-computer interface software systems, focusing on user experience and functionality. Responsibilities include developing software systems, mentoring team members, and designing user experiences centered around brain control.
